item.title: The daily tape · 25 August 2026
item.description: SOAH’s Proposal for Decision in PUCT 59475 Item 6441 (filed 20 Aug 1:52 PM) tells the Commission to deny Oncor/LCRA Import Path 2 — Bell County East–Big Hill and Big Hill–Sand Lake 765-kV. Need not proven; ~1,400 landowners missed the public-meeting process; ERCOT’s Permian Basin Reliability Plan “is not entitled to great weight.” It is a PFD, not a vote. The Silicon Tape did not tick — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69. CoreWeave was confirmed unchanged this morning (L40S spot back on the page at $0.99). Friday’s hole is closed — GCP H100 OD $11.06 and B200 1y CUD $11.12 reconfirmed, unchanged. Not a price tick. NVIDIA FY27 Q2 is tomorrow, 1:20 / 2:00 p.m. PT. Countries: United States: SOAH PFD in PUCT 59475 Item 6441, filed 1:52 PM 20 Aug (SOAH 473-26-16349): ALJs Brite, Burgess, and Chico recommend the Commission deny Oncor/LCRA Import Path 2 — Bell County East–Big Hill and Big Hill–Sand Lake 765-kV. Need not proven under PURA § 37.056; ~1,400 landowners missed Rule 22.52(a)(4) public-meeting process; ERCOT’s PBRP “is not entitled to great weight.” If a route is later selected, ALJs recommend Route 894. This is a proposal for decision, not a Commission order. Exceptions / OM date still to be set. Source: PUCT Interchange 59475 Item 6441. United States: PUCT Project 59142 Item 53, filed 12:29 PM 20 Aug: order granting ERCOT good-cause exceptions from 16 TAC § 25.361(b)(16). Delay classifying Large Loads (≥75 MW) past the 7 Aug Planning Guide deadline; allow eligible-but-unclassified base loads into the 1 Aug and 1 Nov QSAs; 24-day cure on late dynamic-data review. Verification and audit must be completed and reported before Batch Zero continues. Community-impact RFIs to unenergized DC/crypto ≥25 MW. Minutes still unposted. Source: PUCT Interchange 59142_53. United States: ERCOT’s Item 52 (09:01 20 Aug) still holds the working clocks the order does not restate: 17 large DC/crypto loads / 6,608 MW paused at energization; QSA 6 loads ≈1,959 MW and 17 ≈6,874 MW; reports 10 Dec, Open Meeting 17 Dec. April snapshot 157 medium loads ≈8,766 MW. Source: ERCOT / PUCT Interchange 59142_52. United States: Governor Shapiro signed EO 2026-05 on 18 Aug, effective immediately: DEP Consent Order for any data center over 25 MW peak, Fast Track removal, NDA ban, GRID-tied sales-tax exemption. Recitals: 20 DEP applications, PJM 74 GW through 2045. Source: Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. United States: Amazon (18 Aug) raised northwest Louisiana from $12B to $18B and added a third STACK campus in Shreveport. SWEPCO 100% of new energy infra; up to $400M water on Amazon’s tab. IT-MW not disclosed. Source: Amazon. China: FT (19 Aug): ByteDance and Tencent each ~10,000 H200s; Beijing steering most volume to Hong Kong. No new BIS/NDRC/IR primary on 25 Aug. Already on The Wire.
